notes: Independently verified: issue #1095 body (macOS Ventura 13.2.1 arm64, source install, expected "The rclpy package shouldn't fail during the colcon build stage", actual "std::atomic fails to link"); PR #1096 title, merge date, and its single-file diff — the CMake condition change quoted above, exactly as the spec records.
